# ADR-047 D1 allowlist: raw fmt.Fprint* calls that have not moved to pkg/render.
# Format: '<filename> <count>  # reason'. Entries must be sorted by filename.
# The guard fails when a file grows past its count, when a file with calls is
# not listed, and when a listed count is stale (lower it as batches land).
# Measured on 2026-11-05.
#
# Every remaining call is an interactive prompt or diagnostic, not a command
# result. Batches 3-5 (staff, invite, config, update, init, release, pr, audit,
# repair) no longer call fmt.Fprint* for their results.
admin.go 1  # Exempt: interactive prompts and diagnostics, not command results
assets.go 2  # Exempt: interactive prompts and diagnostics, not command results
doc.go 2  # Exempt: interactive prompts and diagnostics, not command results
hostgate.go 1  # Exempt: interactive prompts and diagnostics, not command results
main.go 6  # Exempt: interactive prompts and diagnostics, not command results
ui.go 4  # Exempt: interactive prompts and diagnostics, not command results
